Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Les Misérables", "unit": 142, "heading": "IV OÙ JEAN VALJEAN A TOUT À FAIT L’AIR D’AVOIR LU AUSTIN CASTILLEJO", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr81-u142-r0030", "target": "— Какого живого?", "source_sha256": "998de63ece5d7dbbb1a0ee8d844302cf486a4daa6b5f12b42a16997fe1f5c088", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u142-r0030", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "5e780008db0ecc138ee82b87bb17a1645b2d9edfe540f241041d725f9167fd0c"}, {"source_id": "fr81-u142-r0031", "target": "— Меня, — сказал Жан Вальжан.", "source_sha256": "8a88d8b4260918b5a191557af39a578d9b5429d826614847adf42ba00a71d834", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u142-r0031", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "85b55a5b4b2219fca01d67c186e8c16850036eaf9cc4edd63936858a7dc33b71"}], "source_language": "French", "part": 2, "book": 8, "chapter": 4, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u142-r0032", "tag": "prose", "text": "Fauchelevent, qui s’était assis, se leva comme si un pétard fût parti sous sa chaise.", "sha256": "0cb762b3d76cddfe475aee72a827d71ff944310e068cefae6b1fcfbee720ac4c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0033", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vous !", "sha256": "fc6acf4ac4b83b90e645f16050a245ce0a0184d099a4c03cb87dbce8c3482598", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0034", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Pourquoi pas ?", "sha256": "343fd8e5ef163e40b608bfa4fe702410c418812adfddebff47984a216c70cd83", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0035", "tag": "prose", "text": "Jean Valjean eut un de ces rares sourires qui lui venaient comme une lueur dans un ciel d’hiver.", "sha256": "7dec9df511dec52c35d582ec1c8615e8070310ef3a556946ed0bf01deadadb4e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0036", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vous savez, Fauchelevent, que vous avez dit : La mère Crucifixion est morte, et j’ai ajouté : Et le père Madeleine est enterré. Ce sera cela.", "sha256": "d42430e5a4f6884a7480a02bd0f285c88f7e1842b9d19cf3c70ccfb93485353d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0037", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ah, bon, vous riez. Vous ne parlez pas sérieusement.", "sha256": "4b5189d7c23a5b449fb5266abb868505a82e1756174bb7090117226458f324c2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0038", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Très sérieusement. Il faut sortir d’ici ?", "sha256": "344a56bc1b24808dda9086d99a6f55fa0ebf85f169cd48ae24f3e54ca17080b3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0039", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Sans doute.", "sha256": "f23322d83ff05688a5010f9c11ca6fae65d3b32a72990026b8eb5316d40cb762", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0040", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je vous ai dit de me trouver pour moi aussi une hotte et une bâche.", "sha256": "57dfd3a25d6f7d3cff2695ac34df1b45367f7c053bd7aaebbf9597ac88d4063d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0041", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Eh bien ?", "sha256": "4950a516c968f0619fb8b95afe126297c80c72d6fe6348e65ea081818635e18f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0042", "tag": "prose", "text": "— La hotte sera en sapin, et la bâche sera un drap noir.", "sha256": "95926f3f6291b9b07450a8ba539555ba902f0cffcdd48508a7db0bdf675dd166", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0043", "tag": "prose", "text": "— D’abord, un drap blanc. On enterre les religieuses en blanc.", "sha256": "59e8b293f7403d1bb0cd0954f4e1cad1ce5126d0d53ae791144f3c4be1db0152", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0044", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Va pour le drap blanc.", "sha256": "4371e6d10b81bffd8e19e45a6b04c3c701d825102d6dd162f6b028a565515d95", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0045", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vous n’êtes pas un homme comme les autres, père Madeleine.", "sha256": "cfb70a1033efc69dc52e31cb0a4f4f34f7775e69605c0e016cebd19ff16d94d4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0046", "tag": "prose", "text": "Voir de telles imaginations, qui ne sont pas autre chose que les sauvages et téméraires inventions du bagne, sortir des choses paisibles qui l’entouraient et se mêler à ce qu’il appelait le « petit train-train du couvent », c’était pour Fauchelevent une stupeur comparable à celle d’un passant qui verrait un goéland pêcher dans le ruisseau de la rue Saint-Denis.", "sha256": "2123aaddd4e1c8cf957842ce59fe84f8c55b4c6a9d9cb7c0e59896d7b9aed11d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0047", "tag": "prose", "text": "Jean Valjean poursuivit :", "sha256": "766acdf75a57e0f88d964b0d9eb4940b7919f67c4737c5c255771fea666a64cb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0048", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il s’agit de sortir d’ici sans être vu. C’est un moyen. Mais d’abord renseignez-moi. Comment cela se passe-t-il ? Où est cette bière ?", "sha256": "9a36af4decd0e71c3bd9a72e95e06aa705f8cd11a5891ff3494855570218a87a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0049", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Celle qui est vide ?", "sha256": "a1a0afc0d9cb2d9bec32f76292d78ac758958506544dc5f997261354018b32aa", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0050", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui.", "sha256": "9f4a2e0ce3c8b67038a54bfa044334c55d6f083e8cb634d6147afc7307b16a6f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0051", "tag": "prose", "text": "— En bas, dans ce qu’on appelle la salle des mortes. Elle est sur deux tréteaux et sous le drap mortuaire.", "sha256": "10583c51709f2dce5596226cd097352aa46d4aea2aa7130a31e928defa6bde79", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0052", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quelle est la longueur de la bière ?", "sha256": "0781ed4c7f5b97d17244a00df16ee7a23c246ea7334041f80d5e16403ffa5fb1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0053", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Six pieds.", "sha256": "ddab54a0dce49f6406bbac3d27c2d9874b80173efad669ed2b5b627e5930d846", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0054", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Qu’est-ce que c’est que la salle des mortes ?", "sha256": "e8cb17bc23869304e0bf3f207da04d95e1faa08a5766b8618deb4feb39b9d225", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0055", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est une chambre du rez-de-chaussée qui a une fenêtre grillée sur le jardin qu’on ferme du dehors avec un volet, et deux portes ; l’une qui va au couvent, l’autre qui va à l’église.", "sha256": "2b54c188481a2d9044d7c8f9eec63737293c8602c7563dda2e3c06b704e96362", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0056", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quelle église ?", "sha256": "3b4e3e2fd8ec5f2b6fdc711feca3ffe9286c51cc55db9175ec3e7f624b504a26", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0057", "tag": "prose", "text": "— L’église de la rue, l’église de tout le monde.", "sha256": "a62ad5c5c66cb9267a01657409957bd0d14b9c2a6c2134ba1d3617d6abacc0b6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0058", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Avez-vous les clefs de ces deux portes ?", "sha256": "b8199abb1683650735addc85c61d0da896d052c1ea1951ecb86c20c05fe2d90f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0059", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Non. J’ai la clef de la porte qui communique au couvent ; le concierge a la clef de la porte qui communique à l’église.", "sha256": "17a84d78416d643561326e2d91286ddcfd158252dad96de61144e075fde85967", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0060", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quand le concierge ouvre-t-il cette porte-là ?", "sha256": "f4335d8a50172ce5c01b9b65785cba9d411ef4023ec5191f87bafec79817702f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0061", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Uniquement pour laisser entrer les croque-morts qui viennent chercher la bière. La bière sortie, la porte se referme.", "sha256": "64859f4a453011425ff09bd6bdd4be1daa35921f41057d0368f3556ed6ae4808", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0062", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Qui est-ce qui cloue la bière ?", "sha256": "f0e5fe293432363f9ae120d8165896dff2dac1bd6eb8894051a1efdb556e30f4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u142-r0063", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est moi.", "sha256": "a3fe176cfaff386e600cfbbff42c5cbc67d97552602b479fdf8f33a9cc3d0487", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
